mentions.name: EOL Python fork of pypa/packaging
mentions.description: A fork of the pypa/packaging Python library set up to support end-of-life Python versions back to 3.6, with general simplifications so it remains a reasonably small wheel for use in a smaller target project.
mentions.source_excerpt: setting up a fork of https://github.com/pypa/packaging to support EOL Python (back to 3.6) and make some general simplifications
